Then victim was forced into prostitution. So charges: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" (organizing, forcing, luring, harboring, introducing prostitution) and "强制猥亵" maybe? But the main is "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". So likely charge: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". Also possibly "猥亵儿童" but the facts show he didn't directly commit sexual act, but facilitated. The earlier examples: For forced sexual acts with child, they used "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女". But that was direct assault. Here it's facilitation. So answer: [罪名]组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫<eoa>

Check if any other charges: maybe "拐骗儿童"? He introduced child to prostitution, but not kidnapping. So not.
